# Third-party art assets

ROSVIK: BLACKOUT uses a small set of ready-made CC0 assets for generic art that does not need to be Rosvik-specific. They are fetched during the Windows build so the repository remains lightweight.

## Kenney Nature Kit
Source mirror: https://github.com/syuhei176/ai-game-assets
- `tree_pine.glb` — Kenney Nature Kit
- `rock_large.glb` — Kenney Nature Kit

The source repository identifies these assets as CC0 / Public Domain.

## Kenney Starter Kit Racing
Source: https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-Racing
- `vehicle-truck-green.glb`

The project README states included 3D models are CC0 licensed.

## Kenney Starter Kit 3D Platformer
Source: https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-3D-Platformer
- `character.glb`

The project README states included 3D models are CC0 licensed.

The code of the Kenney starter kits is licensed separately under MIT; ROSVIK: BLACKOUT only downloads the listed CC0 art models above.
